scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:generate && wait-on tcp:5433 tcp:6380 && npm run db:migrate && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec prisma migrate dev -- --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w apps/api && npm test -w packages/workflow-engine && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.test:coverage: c8 --all --include="apps/api/src/**/*.js" --include="packages/workflow-engine/src/**/*.js" --include="workers/*/src/**/*.js" --exclude="**/server.js" --exclude="**/bootstrap.js" --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --check-coverage --lines=70 --statements=70 --branches=55 --functions=55 npm run test:backend && npm run test:coverage -w apps/web
scripts.test:backend: npm run test -w apps/api && npm test -w packages/workflow-engine
scripts.test:db:up: docker compose -p nexora-test -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait && npm run db:test:migrate
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
